picks.title: SOND, a sleep tech startup from Bose's former head of sleep, exits stealth with $7M
picks.why_it_matters: Strong founder-market fit signal—experienced hardware executive from Bose spinning out with domain expertise in an underserved consumer health category represents the type of early-stage opportunity worth tracking.

picks.title: Triomics nabs $22M to bring oncology-specific AI to cancer centers
picks.why_it_matters: Battery-led Series B in vertical AI for healthcare signals continued investor appetite for domain-specific AI applications with clear enterprise buyers and regulatory moats.

picks.title: Corporate America enters its AI reckoning
picks.why_it_matters: Enterprise AI ROI skepticism creates opportunity for startups that can demonstrate measurable value and shorter payback periods versus bloated incumbent solutions.
